responsibility: Handles shipment registration with origin, destination, and delivery deadline; assigns unique tracking identifiers; manages destination changes and enforces registration business rules (distinct origin/destination, fixed origin, mandatory deadline). Manages shipment lifecycle state and the routing decision (associating a selected route with a shipment, marking unrouted shipments, and triggering replanning).

Computes and queries candidate routes (voyages/legs) compatible with a shipment's origin, destination, and deadline; validates route feasibility and returns route itineraries. Corresponds to the pathfinder graph-traversal capability and voyage model.

Records logistics events (receipt, loading, unloading, customs, pickup) from multiple channels (operational interface, REST integration, mobile, and file batch processing), validates events against existing shipment/location/trip, isolates rejected records, and publishes handling events to update shipment status.
Manages the catalog of registered logistics locations used as controlled lists for shipment origin/destination selection and event location validation.

Provides shipment monitoring and tracking: lookup by tracking id, current status, last known location, estimated arrival, event history, off-route flagging, geographic view, and consolidated administrative views grouped by business status.
